summary.text: Matt Harrington is a Republican state senator from Maine Senate District 33 who took office on December 6, 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A law enforcement officer who lives in Sanford, he served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2015 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Matt Harrington, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Harrington, lives in Sanford, Maine.
He earned an A.S. in fire science from Southern Maine Community College in 2007 and a B.A. in criminology from the University of Southern Maine in 2010.
His career experience includes working as a police officer with the Town of Kennebunk and as a firefighter and EMT with the towns of Windham and Gray.
Harrington has served on the board of Sanford Mainers and has been affiliated with the Kora Temple, the Sanford Elks Club and the Maine Association of Police.
Harrington represented House District 19 from 2015 to 2022 before his election to the Senate.
